name: smwpatches-separate-death-and-time-up-deaths
title: Separate Death And Time Up Deaths
description:
This will change Mario's death animation when the timer runs out compared to his normal death animation. Video.

You can configure how long the animation lasts, what music to play, what sound effect to play, and the pose Mario displays when he dies from time up.
